analyzed_vuln.description: `UA_Server_processBinaryMessage` unconditionally calls `connection->close(connection)` on message-processing errors, but does not validate that the `UA_Connection` has a valid function pointer. In the fuzz harness, `createDummyConnection(..., NULL)` leaves callbacks in an unsafe state, and malformed input drives an error path (`UA_Connection_processChunks`/chunk handling failure) that reaches this close call, causing a wild indirect jump/SEGV in libc due to an invalid function pointer target.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires a binary packet that causes `UA_Connection_processChunks` to return an error in `UA_Server_processBinaryMessage` (the provided PoC does this via malformed HEL/OPN/MSG chunk stream). Data flow: fuzzer input -> copied into `UA_ByteString` -> `UA_Server_processBinaryMessage` -> error path -> `UA_Connection_sendError` then `connection->close(connection)`. If `connection->close` is unset/corrupted (as in dummy connection setup with NULL backend), the indirect call crashes.
